Vibroknife Combat Styles

Choose Vibroknife for attacks that exploit Exposed targets or extend Venom and Infection.

Vibroknife - Saboteur

Saboteur attacks apply Exposed and gain extra damage against targets already affected by it.

Vibroknife - Shadow

Shadow attacks apply Venom and can extend Venom or Infection already affecting a target.
